high_level_description: The image depicts two individuals standing indoors against a patterned wallpaper background. The person on the left is dressed in traditional papal attire, which includes a white cassock, a white zucchetto (a small skullcap), and a white pectoral cross around their neck. This individual also has a white cape draped over their shoulders. The person on the right is wearing a dark blazer over a black top, with their hands clasped in front of them.
